result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517). This is the same filter the quarterly purchase-order report uses.

Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the sort order is unchanged.

I ran the purchase-order tests and `DemoScenarioTest`, and they pass. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The method's Javadoc doesn't mention the cancelled exclusion. I left it alone because the same sentence appears in two methods and my edit didn't apply cleanly.
